clauses.why: The verses name Ahimaaz and Jonathan together as the bearers; 'escaping Absalom's servants' is covered by hiding in the well, but 'Ahithophel's counsel' is stated and the citation should include 17:18-19 for the escape.
clauses.english: carried word to King David of Ahithophel's counsel against him, escaping Absalom's servants
clauses.ukr: доніс цареві Давидові про раду Ахітофела проти нього, уникнувши слуг Авесалома
clauses.deu: sagte dem König David den Rat Ahithophels wider ihn an und entkam den Knechten Absaloms
clauses.spa: dio aviso al rey David del consejo de Achitophel contra él, escapando de los criados de Absalom

clauses.why: The verses give the race but not that the news was of the battle; he ran and outran Cushi, then announced peace and blessed the LORD for the victory.
clauses.english: outran Cushi, running to bring King David news
clauses.ukr: випередив кушита, побігши з вісткою до царя Давида
clauses.deu: kam Chusi zuvor, als er lief, um dem König David Botschaft zu bringen
clauses.spa: pasó delante de Cusi, corriendo para llevar nuevas al rey David
